description.narrative: Building on the Post Program Partnership Framework (P3F) of the previous financial sector program, the Financial Sector Deepening Program (FSDP) will support the Government's sector initiatives, to deepen the securities markets and develop related market infrastructure, to increase the role of non-bank financial sector in the financing of economic activity in Viet Nam. The proposed Subprogram 1 (SP1) of FSDP will focus on developing a well functioning money market, promoting a deeper and more liquid Government bond market, and building capacity within public institutions in accordance with the Government human resources development plan.
